name: rheon
description: rheon: the FEEL engine as WebAssembly (exact 34-digit decimals), its TypeScript runtime and the browser playground

scripts.build:playground: npm run notices && npm run build -w @rheon/playground

scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:rust:wasm && npm run test:runtime
